root_cause: POST /api/passes/test and POST /api/passes/:id/redeem dispatched directly to passTestSubscribe/passRedeem without requireAuth, and both functions took the holder email from the request body instead of the session — so any unauthenticated caller could mint credits and permanent signed entitlements for any address. Fix: requireAuth on both routes, bind holder to account.email, 404/403 on missing/foreign passes before any write, testMode:true on pass grants.
